subject.title: fix(plugins): bound before_tool_call hook with a default timeout

question: Should `before_tool_call` adopt the PR's unconditional 15s fail-closed default timeout for existing plugins?
rationale: The code change fixes a real unbounded-wait path and proof is now sufficient, but it changes slow existing handlers from eventual completion to denied tool calls after 15s.

options.title: Accept 15s default
options.body: Land this focused timeout-table fix and rely on existing per-hook timeout overrides for known slow plugins.

options.title: Adjust timeout policy
options.body: Require a longer budget or stronger documented upgrade guidance before changing the default for existing plugins.

options.title: Pause for broader policy
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers want a broader plugin hook timeout policy before changing `before_tool_call`.

recommendation.title: Accept 15s default
recommendation.body: Land this focused timeout-table fix and rely on existing per-hook timeout overrides for known slow plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the listed Hooks/Security owner and has recent history in the hook runner paths affected by this compatibility decision.
